extracted.intended_audience: general public needing unit conversions (students, DIYers, builders, real estate/aviation/sports users)
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and reference for converting lengths from centimeters to feet, including the exact conversion factor, worked examples, common height conversions into feet+inches, contexts where the conversion is used, and quick estimation tips.

rubrics_metrics.name: CM to Feet Conversion Formula
rubrics_metrics.description: To convert centimeters to feet, use this simple formula: Feet = Centimeters ÷ 30.48
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the division by 30.48 to get feet from centimeters. Examples in the page apply this formula to produce decimal feet values (e.g., 100 cm = 100 ÷ 30.48 = 3.28 feet).

rubrics_metrics.name: Exact equivalence of foot and centimeter
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the international standard adopted in 1959; use this exact factor for precise conversions rather than approximations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Centimeter (cm) definition
rubrics_metrics.description: Centimeter (cm) is a unit of length in the metric system, equal to one hundredth of a meter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commonly used for measuring human height, object dimensions, and in construction — use cm where metric units are standard.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foot (ft) definition
rubrics_metrics.description: Foot (ft) is a unit of length in the imperial system, equal to 12 inches or 30.48 centimeters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Widely used in the United States, United Kingdom, and other English-speaking countries; understand this when converting between systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conversion Examples (decimal feet)
rubrics_metrics.description: Worked examples converting round cm values to decimal feet: 100 cm = 3.28 ft; 150 cm = 4.92 ft; 180 cm = 5.91 ft; 200 cm = 6.56 ft.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples demonstrate applying the formula and show typical outputs for common lengths; use these as quick references or checks for manual calculation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Height Conversion to feet and inches
rubrics_metrics.description: When expressing height in feet, it's common to use feet and inches combination (e.g., 170 cm = 5 feet 7 inches, 175 cm = 5 feet 9 inches).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Convert cm to total feet (decimal), then split the fractional foot into inches (1 foot = 12 inches) to produce the conventional feet′inches" format; page provides multiple height examples (170, 175, 180, 185 cm).

rubrics_metrics.name: When to Use CM to Feet Conversion
rubrics_metrics.description: Contexts listed where converting cm to feet is useful: height specifications for documents in English-speaking countries, construction and architecture for international projects, sports (athlete heights in American leagues), aviation (flight altitude often specified in feet), and real estate (room dimensions in US and UK).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose feet or cm output depending on target audience, regulatory or industry standards, and document requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quick Tips for estimation and precision
rubrics_metrics.description: Helpful shortcuts and reminders: 30 cm ≈ 1 foot; average adult height 170–180 cm ≈ 5.6–5.9 feet; when converting fractions remember that 1 foot = 12 inches; use the calculator for precise calculations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use 30 cm ≈ 1 ft for rough mental estimates; for publication or technical work use exact 30.48 cm per ft and/or the online calculator to avoid rounding errors.
